title: Contract Pricing Agreement Substitute Price Protection: Prompt-Payment Concession
content:
Prompt-payment concession — Contract Pricing Agreement substitute price protection

The prompt-payment concession follows the prompt-payment cash discounts earned on the customer's Commercial Credit Account less than 12 whole months before the handling date, each counted by its ledger date. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

| Cash discounts earned in the window | Concession |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.5 percent off |
| At least one and fewer than 6 | 0.25 percent off |
| None | Nothing off |

An amount equal to that percent of the protected price is taken off the protected price before its rounding to four decimal places.

Hypothetical example: four cash discounts in the window and a protected price of 20.0000: 0.25 percent is 0.0500, giving 19.9500.
